changes.title: Journal tabs update without rebuilding the game scene
changes.text: Journal Badges, Catalog, Guide and Alchemy tab selection now replaces only the active tab and updates the highlighted tab. Repeated selection is a no-op. Existing tab contents and real Title exit remain unchanged.

changes.title: News and Changes navigate in place
changes.text: Older and newer pages, technical history mode and version choice update only the current page group, preserving the underlying scene and background. Old page cameras and listeners are disposed on replacement; a real exit still navigates to its destination.
